name: Amerzone: The Explorer's Legacy - Deluxe Edition
summary:
Discover Amerzone Digital Deluxe Edition, boasting exclusive assets specially created by Microids Studio Paris to flesh out the story and the universe depicted in-game and to give players an opportunity to find out more about the work behind the remake and the universe created by Benoît Sokal.

This special edition contains:
Full Game
Animated Short Stories
4K Artworks
Original Soundtrack
Mediabook
